notes.title: Plungeroo 2.0: Galactic Pizza
notes.notes:
It's finally here!  Plungeroo 2.0: Galactic Pizza!  With 27 new puzzles and 3 new worlds ranging from Pizza, to Billiards to the Outer Galaxy!

I hope this final update with it's challenging puzzles rounds out your Plungeroo experience.  Topping out at 100 levels, this will be the final update for now!

Thank you everyone who has played so far, it means the world to me that you took a chance on my little puzzle game!  Good luck with the final worlds! 

-Little Crown Games

notes.title: Dark Mode 1.2.7
notes.notes:
Alright, alright I added a dark mode option but only for worlds 2, 4 and 7.

Also the double rotate with the right mouse button should be fixed as well.

Thanks for playing Plungeroo, and remember, feedback helps us, help you!

notes.title: Update! 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Quite a few updates!

-Puzzle updates for 2-9, 7-9 and 8-8
-Enable "Tap to hold" in settings to disable click and drag
-Use the mouse wheel to rotate pieces 
-Learn some German!

Thank you everyone for your feedback and suggestions!  Here at LCG, [i]you[/i] are royalty to us!

notes.title: Update Notes - Release Day Patch
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone who has played Plungeroo on the day of it's release! And thank you for reporting a few issues that you found.  Please let me know if you encounter any other bugs and I will try to address them promptly

This patch includes:
-Spanish added
-esc button update
-flavor text fix
-World  scrolling/Level select fix
-achievement bug (?) Please let me know if this is still an issue
